name: Git push timeout remote verification
target: Production git CLI push after a transport timeout, verified against one stable push URL, unchanged ordinary loose branch ref identity/content, and unchanged reflog.
inputs: remote accepts the ref update before the client reports timeout
ordinary source ref moves or moves away-and-back are refused
symbolic source refs and symbolic transitions during push are refused
observations: ls-remote target ref and pre-push commit
CLI status line and PARTIAL_OUTCOME receipt
source ref file identity/content and reflog remain stable
entryCommands: bun test src/git-fs/git-cli.test.ts -t "confirms a timed-out push"
